one_month_reasoning: The window runs from 2026-10-02 to the Oct 30 close (Nov 1 is a Sunday). Q3 2026 earnings are probably around Nov 3, just after it. Booking gave four weeks' notice before its last two prints (Sep 30, 2025 for Oct 28, 2025; Jul 7 for Aug 4, 2026) and had given none by Oct 2 (src 16, 23), so I cut P(print inside window) from ~25% to ~15%. Inside the window: the Oct 27-28 FOMC, after the Sep 16 hike to 3.75-4.00% (src 23), plus AI-agent headlines (Meta Muse) and Middle East/oil news. The stock closed at $155.90 on Sep 23 (the recent low) and is at $159. Short-term reversal roughly offsets negative momentum, so I add no drift. The model is a near-symmetric lognormal centred at ~$159.4: 85% weight on sigma 10.8% (38%/3.5) and 15% on sigma 14% for the small chance of an in-window print. P(>= spot) is about 0.51.

fair_value.method: Forward P/E (NTM EPS at Oct 2027 of ~$13.17 x 15x = $198, weight 0.6) blended with an FCF yield (2027E FCF $10.6B less ~$0.6B SBC = $10.0B, at a 7% yield = $143B equity, over ~710M shares = $201, weight 0.4) gives ~$199. The 15x multiple sits between today's ~13.4x NTM and the pre-Muse 16-20x history. That reflects mixed base-rate evidence on whether structural-threat de-ratings revert: 2018-19 BKNG stayed range-bound, while 2026 software (IGV) fully recovered within ~7 months.

bear.story: AI agents (Meta Muse, OpenAI/Google agents) visibly take paid and direct traffic and pressure take rates. The Middle East drag persists, and the Sep 16 Fed hike plus oil weigh on travel. EPS growth slows to high single digits (NTM ~$12.2) and the multiple compresses to ~9.5x: -28%.

base.story: Low-teens EPS growth, about half of it from ~6%/yr share shrink. Long-haul demand normalizes in 2027 and there is no visible disintermediation. As in 2018-19, the multiple stays compressed and recovers only to ~13.7x NTM EPS of ~$13.2.

bull.story: Booking becomes a preferred supply partner to AI agents. Demand recovers, and the multiple re-rates to ~17-18x as in the 2022 and 2026-software rebounds, which fully reverted within 7-8 months.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$118 the stock would be ~9.5x FY27 consensus EPS ($12.37) and yield ~11% on FCF. That is about 49% below the all-time high, past the 2022 drawdown (-39.5%) and near the COVID trough (-47.8%). Ordinary volatility, macro headlines or the Fed would not get it there. Only evidence of structural disintermediation (falling direct traffic, take-rate cuts, flat room nights) or a deep travel recession would.

reasoning: Anchors: BKNG is at $159, ~32% below its July 2025 high (src 6). Its past 30%+ drawdowns recovered: 2015-16 in ~7 months, 2022 in ~7 months, and 2018-20 only after ~2 years. Following the supervisor's challenge, I looked for base rates on de-ratings driven by a perceived structural threat. 2018-19 (Google Hotel Ads) is the closest analog. The multiple compressed only to ~17-19x (src 21), but the price went sideways: Dec 2019 was still below Apr 2018 (src 19). The Feb 2026 AI-disruption software sell-off (IGV -24%) fully reverted by October (src 20). So reversion within 12 months happens, but not reliably, and I cut my multiple from 16x to 15x and my FCF yield from 6.5% to 7%. I also took on the supervisor's corrections. FY27 consensus is $12.37 (39 analysts); I haircut it 3% to $12.00, and the $12.36 I cited in round 1 was Erste's single-broker figure. Shares are 751.4M and falling ~6%/yr, not ~750M in 2027. Net debt should not be subtracted from an FCF-yield equity value. The Q2 print was Aug 4. Fair value falls from $210 to $199. The 12-month distribution is a lognormal mix with median ~$170 (+7%): 80% weight at sigma 0.33 and 20% at sigma 0.45 for fat tails (an AI-structural break on the left, a 2022-style re-rating on the right). The upper tail is trimmed slightly from round 1 for the lower fair value. Scenario mean ~$177. P(>= $159) = 0.575; P(>= $215) = 0.235. Research was limited to a few follow-up queries. The Columbia PDF could not be text-extracted, so its multiple comes from the search snippet. The Seeking Alpha page was blocked.
